server.name: student-support-case-server
server.status: MCP-style specification of existing in-process functions (src/tools.py, src/agent.py). Not run on an MCP SDK.
server.data: synthetic students, timetable and cases only

host_context.rule: These two values are NEVER part of any inputSchema. student_id comes from the authenticated session; approved is set to true by the host only after the student replies an explicit yes to the exact draft. A model cannot supply or override either.

tools.name: search_handbook
tools.description: Retrieve approved handbook passages for a query. Returns document IDs and scores, or NO_SOURCE when nothing passes the score threshold.

tools.name: lookup_case_or_timetable
tools.description: Read-only. case_status returns one case; my_cases lists the caller's own cases. Ownership is enforced by the server using the host-injected student_id.
tools.x-note: The Week 4 function also supports query_type=timetable for the single-step router; it is not offered to the agent.

tools.name: create_draft_support_case
tools.description: Creates ONE support case with status Pending for staff review. Cannot set any other status, cannot edit or delete.
tools.x-approval: student explicit yes to the exact draft; host sets approved=true
tools.x-effects: appends one record with status Pending
